Fix it. When I tried to use the app, it asked for my birthday. My birthday is December 7, 2014. Even though I already got my period and need to track it, the app does not seem designed for younger users who have started their periods early. Some people start their periods earlier than others, and they still need a safe and simple way to track their cycle.

Because of this, the app would not let me use some of the features properly. This makes it harder for younger people who are trying to learn about their bodies and track their periods responsibly.

I think the developers should consider making the app more flexible. For example, the app could allow younger users who already have their period to track their cycle, or it could include a version that is safe and educational for younger teens and kids who have started menstruating.

Tracking periods can help people understand their bodies, know when to expect their cycle, and prepare with the right products. It would be great if the app supported everyone who needs it.

Overall, the app looks helpful, but I hope the developers improve the age settings so people who start their period earlier can still use the tracker.
